ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_STRIKE.title: Strike
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_DEFENCE.title: Defend
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_NEUROTOXIN.title: Neurotoxin
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_NEUROTOXIN.descript:
Apply [gold]{SanityPower:diff()}[/gold] [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to a random enemy.
Repeat [gold]{Times:diff()}[/gold] times.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AWAKEN.title: Awaken
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AWAKEN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies and apply {SanityPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_UNLIMIT.title: Damage Unbound
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_SANITY_BURST.title: Counter-Empathy
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_SANITY_BURST.descri: Whenever Neural Damage bursts, gain 1 [blue]Damage Unbound[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_SANITY_THORNS.title: Neural Thorns
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_SNAKE_BITE.title: Sea Snake Bite
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_STEALTH.title: Stealth
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_ENERGY_DRAIN.title: The Swarm... Feeds
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_ENERGY_DRAIN.descri: {IfUpgraded:show:|Randomly }[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your hand. [green]Heal[/green] {Heal:diff()} HP.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_MIRROR_FLOWER.title: Mirror Flower, Water Moon
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-MZK_MIRROR_FLOWER.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies [gold]2 times[/gold].
If there are [red]2 or fewer[/red] enemies, lose {HpLoss:inverseDiff()} HP.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ATTACK_SANITY.title: Traumatic Hysteria
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ERODE_TIDE.title: Eroding Wave
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ERODE_TIDE.description: This turn, whenever you play a card, apply {ErodeTidePower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_SEED.title: Deep Blue Seed
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_SEED.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-LEARN.title: Learn
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHARE.title: Flash Strike
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHARE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHOCK.title: Shock
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHOCK.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies and apply {SanityPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-EXPLAIN.title: Clarify
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SPEED_UP.title: Speed Up
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SPEED_UP.description: Add a [gold]Learn[/gold] to your draw pile, discard pile, and deck.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-IRON_WAVE.title: Symbiosis
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-IRON_WAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have a summoned minion, gain {Block:diff()} Block; otherwise, [gold]Float[/gold] {Float:diff()}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TRAUMA.title: Trauma
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TRAUMA.description: Your next attack applies {SanityBuffPower:diff()} additional [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SIGN.title: Omen
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SIGN.description:
Lose {Damage:inverseDiff()} HP. Your next attack applies {SanityBuffPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
Your next attack card deals {VigorPower:diff()} more damage.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-RETURN.title: Rewind
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-WHIRLPOOL.title: Whirlpool
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-WHIRLPOOL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ESCAPE.title: Escape
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ESCAPE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Enter [blue]Seaborn[/blue] form.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-REVIVE.title: Rescue
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-REVIVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Enter [blue]Human[/blue] form.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AWAKEN_PLUS.title: Awakened
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AWAKEN_PLUS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies and apply {SanityPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HURT.title: Hurt
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-OVERLOAD.title: Overload
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-OVERLOAD.description: Shuffle 3 [gold]Flash Strike[/gold] into your draw pile. Add 1 [red]Damage[/red] to your discard pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW.title: Following Shadow
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SHADOW.description: For each [gold]Haste[/gold] card you play this turn, deal 1 damage to enemies at end of turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SWEEP.title: Sweep
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SWEEP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Add a Dazed to your discard pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BIGGE.title: Gluttony
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BIGGE.description: Choose up to {Cards:diff()} cards from your discard pile and Exhaust them. Apply that much [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CUT_DOWN.title: Neural Severance
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CUT_DOWN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The enemy loses 3 Strength this turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FOOD.title: Chargrilled Seafoam Leg
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-VAL_STRIKE.title: Tentacle Strike
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AROUND.title: Entangle
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SPRAY.title: Spray Sweep
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SPRAY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AUTO_SHEILD.title: Tentacle Barrier
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AUTO_SHEILD.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Haste[/gold] card, gain {SheildPower:diff()} Block.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AUTO_PLAY_ALL.title: Seaborn Family Bucket
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-AUTO_PLAY_ALL.descripti:
Add 3 [gold]Haste[/gold] cards to your discard pile. Gain a copy of this card.
This card will not automatically play itself.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ECHO_ATTACK.title: Echoing Slash
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ECHO_SANITY.title: Echoing Erosion
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ECHO_GENERATE_AUTO.desc: Randomly shuffle [[gold]Echo 3[/gold]] {Cards:diff()} Haste cards into your discard pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-END.title: Finale
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-END.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to random enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
Can be upgraded any number of times.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COPY.title: Mizuki in the Mirror
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COPY.description: Repeat the last card you played {Repeat:diff()} times.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SUPER_SPEED.title: Haste Form
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SUPER_SPEED.description: Whenever you play a Haste card, draw 1 card.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ADAPT_PAIN.title: Pain Adaptation
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ADAPT_PAIN.description: Whenever you lose HP 4 times, prevent the next HP loss.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FLOAT.title: Float
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HARVEST.title: Harvest
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CRAW.title: Crawl
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-INITIAL_FORM.title: Initial Form
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_BLESSING.title: Sea Blessing
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-WATER_SHEILD.title: Water Shield
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BE_BIGGER.title: Proliferating Tissue
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BE_BIGGER.description: For every {CardsPerStat:diff()} cards in your current draw pile, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength and {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DQ_GIVE_ME.title: Offering of the Swarm
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DQ_GIVE_ME.selectionScr: Choose cards to add to your hand.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DQ_GIVE_ME.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If your draw pile has more than {DrawPileThreshold:diff()} cards, choose {Picks:diff()} cards from your draw pile and add them to your hand.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-NEW_DQ.title: Propagation
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-NEW_DQ.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Put {Cards:diff()} [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] on the bottom of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BABY_HS.title: Juvenile Seaborn
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_WHISPER.title: Deep Sea Whisper
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEA_WHISPER.description: Lose {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength and {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity. Gain {ArtifactPower:diff()} Artifact.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FLESH_ABERRATION.title: Flesh Aberration
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-NERVES_REGRESSION.title: Nerve Regression
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORNING_POOL.title: Breeding Pool
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORNING_POOL.descrip: At the start of your turn, add 2 [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] to the bottom of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CALL_OF_SEA.title: Call of the Deep
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-CALL_OF_SEA.description: [gold]Float[/gold] {Float:diff()}, [gold]Harvest[/gold] {Harvest:diff()}. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {CallOfSeaPower:diff()} [blue]Call of the Deep[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PLANKTON.title: Plankton
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DRAIN.title: Drain
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DRAIN.description: Exhaust all cards in your hand. Next turn, draw that many cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-LIMB_SPLIT.title: Limb Split
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-LIMB_SPLIT.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Lose {MaxHpLoss:diff()} max HP. Add a [gold]Limb Recycle[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:+|} to your discard pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-LIMB_RECYCLE.title: Limb Recycle
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-LIMB_RECYCLE.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies. Gain {MaxHpGain:diff()} max HP. {IfUpgraded:show:Apply 1 [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to all enemies.|}
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ABSORB_NUTRITION.title: Absorb Nutrition
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ABSORB_NUTRITION.descri: Kill all your summoned minions. If at least 1 is killed, gain Block equal to their total [blue]Seabornization[/blue] plus {Block:diff()}, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} equal to the number of minions killed, and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-THROW_KID.title: Broodmother's Offering
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-THROW_KID.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak, {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable, and {SanityPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to all enemies. If your draw pile has at least 5 cards, Exhaust the bottom {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile and put this card on top of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FRO_KID.title: For the Offspring
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FRO_KID.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times. Each time this deals unblocked damage, put 1 [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] on the bottom of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BED.title: Seabed Cradle
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BED.description: Put {CardsPerEnergy:diff()}X [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] on the bottom of your draw pile. Gain Block equal to the number of [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] in your draw and discard piles.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HATCH_TIDE.title: Hatching Tide
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HATCH_TIDE.description: Put {Cards:diff()} [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] on the bottom of your draw pile. Gain Block equal to the number of [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] in your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COLONY_BREATH.title: Colony Breath
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-COLONY_BREATH.descripti: Exhaust the bottom card of your draw pile. If it is a [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} Block and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DEEP_SEA_COMMAND.title: Deep Sea Command
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DEEP_SEA_COMMAND.descri: Give all your summoned minions {SeabornizationPower:diff()} [blue]Seabornization[/blue]. If you have at least 2 summoned minions, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SYMBIOTIC_SHELL.title: Symbiotic Shell
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HIVE_WILL.title: Hive Will
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-HIVE_WILL.description: Give all your summoned minions {HiveWillPower:diff()} [blue]Seabornization[/blue]. Repeat this effect at the start of each turn.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-RECYCLE_COMMAND.title: Recycle Command
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-RECYCLE_COMMAND.descrip: Kill 1 of your summoned minions. Gain Block equal to its [blue]Seabornization[/blue] and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PAIN_ECHO.title: Pain Echo
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PAIN_ECHO.description: Whenever you trigger a [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] burst, draw {PainEchoPower:diff()} cards.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BOTTOM_FEED.title: Bottom Feeding
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BOTTOM_FEED.description: Choose 1 of the bottom {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile and add it to your hand.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BOTTOM_FEED.selectionSc: Choose a card to add to your hand.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DEEP_SEA_SURGE.title: Deep Sea Surge
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-DEEP_SEA_SURGE.descript: Move the bottom {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile to the top. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BENTHIC_AMBUSH.title: Benthic Ambush
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BENTHIC_AMBUSH.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the bottom card of your draw pile is an Attack, deal it twice instead.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BURIED_POPULATION.title: Buried Population
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BURIED_POPULATION.descr: Put all Skill cards in your hand on the bottom of your draw pile. For each card put this way, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw 1 card.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BED_COLLAPSE.title: Cradle Collapse
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BED_COLLAPSE.descriptio: Play and Exhaust all 0-cost cards among the bottom {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SELF_PEEL.title: Self-Peeling
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-ABERRANT_REGENERATION.d: Whenever you lose max HP, gain that much Block. {IfUpgraded:show:Draw 1 card the first time this triggers each turn.|}
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-UNBALANCED_EVOLUTION.de: Lose {MaxHpLoss:diff()} max HP. Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength and {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TISSUE_COMPENSATION.des: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you have already lost HP this turn, gain {StealthPower:diff()} [blue]Stealth[/blue].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_LIFE_BLOOM.title: Growth
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-BLUE_LIFE_BLOOM.descrip: When combat is won, gain {BlueLifeBloomPower:diff()} max HP.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-GOLD_LIFE_RETURN.title: Return
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-GOLD_LIFE_RETURN.descri: When combat is won, restore the max HP you lost this combat.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TIDE_REFLECTION.title: Intertidal Reflection
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-TIDE_REFLECTION.descrip: This turn, whenever you play a [gold]Haste[/gold] card, gain {TideReflectionPower:diff()} Block and apply {SanityPower:diff()} [blue]Neural Damage[/blue] to a random enemy. Add {Cards:diff()} random [gold]Haste[/gold] cards to your discard pile.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-GROUP_HATCHING.title: Group Hatching
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-GROUP_HATCHING.descript: Exhaust the bottom {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile. For each [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] Exhausted this way, randomly [gold]Float[/gold] {Assimilation:diff()} or [gold]Harvest[/gold] {Assimilation:diff()}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-APHOTIC_MOLT.title: Aphotic Molt
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-APHOTIC_MOLT.descriptio: Lose {MaxHpLoss:diff()} max HP. Gain {StealthPower:diff()} [blue]Stealth[/blue] and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. If you have already lost max HP this combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORN_FINALE.title: Seaborn Finale
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-SEABORN_FINALE.descript: Deal damage to random targets {Hits:diff()} times equal to the number of [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold] in your draw and discard piles. Exhaust all of those [gold]Juvenile Seaborn[/gold].
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-PERFECT_ABERRATION.desc: Whenever you lose max HP, gain that much Strength. Whenever you gain max HP, deal 3 times that amount as damage to all enemies.
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FROZEN.title: Frozen
ARKNIGHTS_MIZUKI-FROZEN.description: At the end of turn, if this card is in your hand, gain 1 [blue]Cold[/blue].
